title: Grateful Dead Live at USAir Arena on 1994-10-09

ai_review.summary: Decent audience recording of a solid 1994 show with consistent playing but no standout moments.
ai_review.review: Both sets are praised for having "the stuff" and delivering solid performances across a big setlist, though reviewers note there are no major highlights. The audio is an audience (AUD) source that isn’t top‑notch, resulting in a fair listening experience rather than crystal‑clear sound.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is average‑to‑good (well‑played but no highlights) and recording quality is fair, yielding a combined rating around the low‑mid 3s.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners mention the audio is "not the best AUD," indicating typical audience tape limitations and lack of clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Both sets are described as solid with big setlists, but reviewers note a lack of major highlight moments.
